sourceQuote: Future Career The graduates mainly work in the relevant enterprises, intermediary agencies and scientific research units such as institutions of higher learning in the Safety Technology and Engineering, Safety Inspection and Supervision, Safety Design and Production, Safety Education and Training of Senior Engineering in Building, Chemical, Mining, Energy and Transportation field.
targetQuote: 未来职业 毕业生主要在相关企业、中介机构和科研单位工作，如高等院校从事安全技术与工程、安全检查与监督、安全设计与生产、安全教育与培训等领域的教学和科研工作，以及建筑、化工、采矿、能源和交通领域的高级工程工作。
